0022600225.text: The Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak) visit the Rockets (8-3, on a one-game winning streak) for Golden State's 12th game of the season. Golden State is without Gary Payton II, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Will Richard, and Brandon Williams is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision, while Houston is missing Clint Capela and Steven Adams and Oscar Tshiebwe is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. There are no games yet between the teams in 2026-27, while the Warriors lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, and their most recent meeting was a 117-116 Warriors loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
